WITH Balance AS (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountID
,BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount AS OutstandingBalanceAmount
,BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
--,CASE WHEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount > 0 AND BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount > 0 THEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount + BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount
--      WHEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount > 0 AND BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount <= 0 THEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
--      WHEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount <= 0 AND BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount > 0 THEN BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount
--      WHEN BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount < 0 AND BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount < 0 THEN 0
--      ELSE 0 END
--      AS RelationshipExposure
,SUM(Case WHEN TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount > 0 THEN TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount ELSE 0 END + 
    CASE WHEN OutstandingInstallmentAmount > 0 THEN OutstandingInstallmentAmount ELSE 0 END ) RelationshipExposure
,BPCS.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
[BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary]  BPCS
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BPCS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL 
)

select * into dw.factccdrelexp_Balance from Balance;

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,convert(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
     dw.factccdrelexp_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)  AND BusinessDateSK between '20230626' and '20230703' 
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, OutstandingBalanceAmount, OutstandingInstallmentAmount, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm, RelationshipExposure
FROM  dw.factccdrelexp_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,OutstandingBalanceAmount
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,RelationshipExposure
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [OutstandingBalanceAmount] is null and [OutstandingInstallmentAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factccdrelexp_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factccdrelexp_rowgrp from dw.factccdrelexp_join_balance

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when RelationshipExposure is not null then RelationshipExposure else first_value(RelationshipExposure) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end RelationshipExposure
,case when [OutstandingBalanceAmount] is not null then OutstandingBalanceAmount else first_value(OutstandingBalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end OutstandingBalanceAmount
,case when [OutstandingInstallmentAmount] is not null then OutstandingInstallmentAmount else first_value(OutstandingInstallmentAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from dw.factccdrelexp_rowgrp BCPB)

select * into dw.factccdrelexp_final_balance from final_balance;

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,OutstandingBalanceAmount
    ,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,RelationshipExposure
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,OutstandingBalanceAmount
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,RelationshipExposure
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm  
from  dw.factccdrelexp_final_balance   BCPB

drop table dw.factccdrelexp_Balance
drop table dw.factccdrelexp_join_balance
drop table dw.factccdrelexp_rowgrp
drop table dw.factccdrelexp_final_balance
